metadata.title: When you get 2 kills and suddenly think you’re the MVP of Valorant
metadata.description:
Wait, how did those kills even happen? My aim was definitely napping.
Watch me fake confidence like I planned it all.
Valorant logic: making no sense since forever.
Click if your accidental clutches are your pride!

Tap if your luck once made you feel like a pro!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckygamer #funnyclips #clutch
